notes.title: 55% off Castles Now
notes.notes:
Castles is an action puzzle game, set in a fantasy medieval world. Up to two players have to rise the highest tower in the kingdom, matching blocks of materials and construction tools, and facing problems like weather and giant bosses.

The players don’t control blocks, instead, they control the “engineers”, which makes for a very different game experience. Blocks will fall from above onto the central 5×5 grid, where the player have to push and pull them in order to make combinations. If you complete the level goals, the tower grows taller. As it grows, different challenges in the shape of weather effects or enemies will get in the way.

Players also can play in the arena, trying to survive as long as they can, or compete one against other.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/384010

notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.notes:
[b]Hi all![/b]

Christmas has gone,  Spring is on the air, and Castles gets some changes in order to keep improving.

We have improved the game performance, and most of you will notice it in a much better frame rate and some visual improvements.
The other major update is on the controls area, now recognizing PS4 and XBox One controllers more efficiently.

Joy and happiness.


[b]Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*]	UI now shows icons depending on the controller used by P1
[*]	Improved quality settings
[*]	Visual Improvements all over the game
[*]	PS4 controller compatible
[*]	XBox One controller improved
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.2 has arrived!
notes.notes:
[b]Hi tower builders![/b]

Christmas has come to Castles, and we will like to Celebrate by adding an  addictive new game Mode, Versus Mode, that lets you play against a friend in order to see who's the best tower builder.

Snow covers the city, but this won't stop our tireless builders, that have suited their Christmas clothes and changed their cubes for gift boxes.

[b]Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*]	New versus mode (competitive)
[*]	Redesigned interface
[*]	Balanced difficulty.
[*]	Winter Christmas theme
[*]	All languages supported are now fully updated 
[*]	Improved optimizations and performance
[*]	Rebalanced sound effects/music
[/list]

notes.title: Competitive Mode is coming to Castles!
notes.notes:
Castles Free Downloadable Content to include competition mode and Christmas content -- $4.99 during the Steam Holiday sale!

Madrid, Spain (December 21, 2015) -- Christmas is nearly here and with it comes the arrival of fresh downloadable content for Castles, the match-3 style puzzler released by BadLand Indie and WhootGames on Steam in October.  Castles currently features a survival mode and a story mode.  Now Jonathan Rivas, CTO of WhootGames, says "Enough with cooperative gameplay. It's competition time!" The update will allow players to do what they've always wanted -- challenge a best friend, partner in crime, or sibling to a death match.  Individual play is rewarding, co-op is fun for a while, but competitive battles are where it's really at!

Also, for a limited time, players will enjoy a Christmas backdrop as they attempt to build the tallest tower ever seen for the beloved King Harold. New character skins and a cheerful Christmas snowfall will brighten the ascent and player's faces from now until January.

Buy Castles for $4.99 during the Steam holiday sale! The sale runs from Tuesday, December 22nd at 10:00AM PST to January 4th at 10:00 AM PST.

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
[b]Hi everyone![/b]

We’ve read through all your comments/feedback, and worked hard during the last weeks to bring up an update that improves a lot of things all over the game.
We’ll keep working even harder from now on, to bring you more content updates and improve the experience.
Hope you enjoy! 

[b]Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*]	Added Steam Cloud support. Yay!
[*]	Improved Microsoft Gamepads control: Xbox 360 & Xbox One controllers now respond more efficiently.
[*]	Changed default keyboard mapping to a more intuitive one.
[*]	New mechanic on the 4th Boss Stage  “Twins”.
[*]	Fixed text speed on presentation (Spanish and English only, other languages on coming updates).
[*]	Balanced difficulty on Survival Mode.
[*]	Balanced difficulty on Story Mode.
[*]	Balanced music/effects default volume.
[*]	Minor performance and visual updates.
[*]	Fixed some notified bugs.
[/list]
